title: Vikram and Betal: The Helpful Neighbor

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about two neighbors.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a kind neighbor and a selfish neighbor.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: A strong storm damaged many houses in the village.
The kind neighbor helped fix homes and shared food.
scenes.image_prompt: neighbor helping villagers repair houses cartoon

scenes.text: The selfish neighbor stayed inside and did not help.
scenes.image_prompt: selfish neighbor sitting inside while others struggle cartoon

scenes.text: The villagers thanked the kind neighbor. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A kind neighbor helped others during a storm while a selfish one did nothing. The kind neighbor found true happiness. Vikram said helping others brings happiness.
